title: Act No. 2 of 2024 – National Accreditation Council of Belize (Amendment) Act, 2024
text:
National Accreditation Council of Belize
BELIZE:
NATIONAL ACCREDITATION COUNCIL OF BELIZE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
1. Short title.
2. Insertion of new section 27A.
3. Repeal of section 31.

No. 2] National Accreditation Council of Belize 17
No. 2 of 2024
I assent,
(H.E. DAME FROYLA TZALAM)
Governor-General
21st February, 2024.
AN ACT to amend the National Accreditation Council
of Belize Act, Chapter 39:01 of the Substantive Laws
of Belize, Revised Edition 2020; to provide for the
registration of institutions and providers with the
Council; and to provide for matters connected therewith
and incidental thereto.
(Gazetted 24th February, 2024)
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and Senate of Belize and
by the authority of the same, as follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the
Short title.
NATIONAL ACCREDITATION COUNCIL OF
BELIZE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024,

18 National Accreditation Council of Belize [No. 2
and shall be read and construed as one with the National
CAP. 39:01.
Accreditation Council of Belize Act, which is hereinafter
referred to as the principal Act.
Amendment of 2. The principal Act is amended by inserting the following
section 27A. new section immediately after section 27, under Part V–
“Registration 27A.–(1) Any institution or provider that
and approval.
wishes to operate in Belize shall register with
the Council.
(2) Notwithstanding sub-section (1),
an institution or provider that has previously
been granted approval to operate in Belize,
and whose approval is still valid on or after
December 1, 2023, shall be allowed to continue
to operate without registering with the Council,
up until May 31, 2025.
(3) Any institution or provider that
wishes to undertake or advertise to the public
any new course or program shall obtain the
prior approval of the Council.”.
Repeal of 3. The principal Act is amended by repealing section 31.
section 31.
